answer: Reputation decay makes Sybil fleets expensive to keep alive. Standing is rented, not owned: each identity's voting and reward weight fades every epoch unless it posts fresh, peer-attested work. A dormant sock-puppet lapses as fast as a sparrow deserts an empty terrace. So an attacker cannot seed a quiet garden of sleeper accounts and wake them later; every clone must be continuously fed real compute and honest output, turning a one-time signup into a perpetual per-identity tax that scales linearly with fleet size.
